quest.title: Pre-Packaged Solution
quest.description: After a brief battle, you manage to suppress the monsters in the ruins, collecting a large amount of data on Frejus's cannon in the process...

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: These results are far, far better than expected!

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: Even a whole company couldn't take out as many monsters as you! Based on the current situation, there's no way those monsters can escape the ruins.

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: How do you feel? Was it hard work?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Urgh, yeah. Those muzzle flashes aren't super bright, but Paimon still got dizzy from staring at them for too long...

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: No problem! A paper I once read mentioned that you can suppress the flash by installing a device at the end of the barrel. It helps lower visual fatigue when firing for long periods.

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: Anyway, the crisis has been averted, and we've collected enough data to ensure the next version of my cannon will be even better!

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: I can't thank you enough for your help, Proto-Boss — and, of course, for that of your little assistant!

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: And lest we forget the vital role you played, Miss Marine... The reward money has already been earmarked for our Proto-Boss, but once I've sold the cannon, I'll split the proceeds with you — fifty-fifty!

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: Huh? You want to split the money with me!?

response.speaker: Marine
response.text: I don't care much for Mora, but I wouldn't say no to some fermented Tidalga... and it needs to be wheat-based alcohol, none of that fruity nonsense.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon hasn't tried fermented Tidalga before, but it sounds like it's worth a try...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure — we can just swap the alcohol with Fonta! That'll do the trick!

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: I've never heard of this dish before... Where would I go to find it?

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: This sounds like a perfect opportunity to invent an "Automated Tidalga Pickler."

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: After all, your Automatic Breakfast Oven works wonders. You clearly have a knack for culinary devices.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Moreover, the market for this sort of food preparation device is huge. It's not like trying to sell cannons, where you need to display their exceptional performance against powerful opponents.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: And you don't have to run off to dangerous areas and battle monsters and the like every time you want to test a toaster.

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: Hmm, you make a good point. Maybe I should try switching my focus...

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: That said, if I did decide to become an inventor of machines with culinary applications — let's call them kitchen "appliances" — wouldn't all my previous work go to waste? And besides... I'd no longer have any connection to the Gardes!

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: You...

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: *sigh* I guess you're right... Giving up on all your previous work isn't really your style.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Come to think of it, apart from installing Gardemeks' target identification module on our cannon, we could also have some actual Gardemeks serve as "bodyguard meks" within its unit.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: With that specialized protection detail in place, we shouldn't have to worry about monsters getting into our gun's blind spots.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: That way, you can combine all these machines together and sell them as a "Pre-Packaged Solution"...

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: Oh! That's not a bad idea! Solving all our customers' problems with one complete package... That's definitely something worth looking into!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's like they just need to start chatting and the ideas come flowing out...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: I bet if we locked them in a room together and kept them there for a few weeks, they'd come up with all sorts of new inventions!

choices.text: You shouldn't eat just anything, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon feels like there's a flock of seagulls screaming inside her head!

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: I have a solution for that! An abandoned engineering project I read mentioned using a multi-chambered muzzle device to slow down the gases responsible for the noise and make the cannon quieter. Unfortunately, the materials required are quite expensive...
